description: This file contains an abstract assertion class for CommandResponse objects in a testing framework, providing methods to verify various properties of the command responses.

classes.name: AbstractCommandResponseAssert
classes.description: An abstract class for asserting properties of CommandResponse objects in tests, extending a generic JSON assert base class.

methods.name: hasType
methods.description: Asserts that the CommandResponse has the expected type.

methods.name: hasName
methods.description: Asserts that the CommandResponse has the expected name.

methods.name: hasDittoHeaders
methods.description: Asserts that the CommandResponse has the specified Ditto headers.

methods.name: hasEmptyDittoHeaders
methods.description: Asserts that the CommandResponse has no Ditto headers.

methods.name: hasCorrelationId
methods.description: Asserts that the CommandResponse contains the expected correlation ID.

methods.name: hasJsonSchemaVersion
methods.description: Asserts that the CommandResponse has the specified JSON schema version.

methods.name: containsAuthorizationSubject
methods.description: Asserts that the CommandResponse contains the specified authorization subjects.

methods.name: hasStatus
methods.description: Asserts that the CommandResponse has the expected HTTP status code.

methods.name: hasStatusCode
methods.description: Asserts that the CommandResponse has the expected HTTP status code value.

methods.name: hasResourcePath
methods.description: Asserts that the CommandResponse has the expected resource path.

methods.name: hasManifest
methods.description: Asserts that the CommandResponse has the expected manifest string.
